Definition: to close up; especially to seal
BiblicalUsage: 1) to seal, seal up, affix a seal; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to seal, affix one's seal; 1a2) to seal up, fasten up by sealing; 1b) (Niphal) to seal; 1c) (Piel) to lock up; 1d) (Hiphil) to be stopped
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
